title: SignLockedChests
body:
# What It Is
Sign Locked Chests is a simple Lockette/LWC clone for Forge 1.7.10.

It's not foolproof, chests are still vulnerable to hoppers and explosions, but it's probably good enough for a server with your friends.

# How To Use It
Craft a sign and place it onto a chest, that's it.

**Ops are able to bypass locks.**

# For Servers
**Players need to have Forge**, but the mod only needs to be installed on the server side.
